ValidationRule.description: Check fields needed for Edu ARR Calculation are filled in to add product
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', Opportunity.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Education', Family__c = 'Cross Border', OR ( ISBLANK(Opportunity.Account.ShippingCountry), ISBLANK(TEXT(Opportunity.Account.Account_Sub_Industry__c)), AND( ISBLANK(TEXT(Opportunity.Account.Ownership_Type__c)), Opportunity.Account.ShippingCountry = 'Australia' ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The following Account fields are required to calculate ARR: Shipping Country, Account Sub Industry, Ownership Type (For Australia Only), Go the your Account and fill these in before adding product.
